hook.text: Nelson plays the cavaquinho on this LP for the first time, an instrument he had given up for the guitar.

sentences.text: Among the songs recorded for the LP are Juízo Final, Folhas Secas, A Flor e o Espinho, Rugas and Quando Eu Me Chamar Saudade.
Guilherme de Brito shares the writing credit on many of the tracks.
Élcio Soares, Nourival Bahia and Jair do Cavaquinho each co-wrote one track with him.

listen_for.text: Guilherme de Brito appears as a special guest on this track.
